_scenario: One §18 AnimationController over four states (idle, walk, run, land) on a shared ClipTarget — the character node's own Transform plus a ColorRGBA tuple — with six transitions covering numeric comparisons, a Boolean condition, a latched trigger, cross-fade durations of 0.2-0.4 s, an exit-time gate of 0.6 s, and one uninterruptible fade. Driven by a scripted parameter schedule (SCHEDULE in the helper) applied between fixed steps, over 600 clean 1/60 s frames through Application's fixed-step scheduler with an AnimationSystem at §39 step 3. Every per-step digest is an FNV-1a checksum (plan D6, 1e-6 quantization) over position (3), transform.scale.x, colour (4), the active state's index into STATE_NAMES, and the transition weight — 10 numbers in that fixed order.
_tier: §33 same-runtime, recorded. The scenario's own arithmetic is cross-platform-exact — every track is "linear" over number/vector3/color, so every value comes from a + (b - a) * t, and the transition weight from one division and a Math.min; there is no transcendental anywhere, unlike phase4's slerp and sine-in-out easing. The recorded tier stays same-runtime because §33's cross-platform tier is a claim about the whole engine, which this file cannot make alone.
